title: Minimum Time to Make Rope Colorful
spaceBreakdown:
- int n, totalCost, i, j, sum, maxTime: six scalars → O(1)
- no containers, no recursion, no heap/stack allocations
- not counted: input string and vector (LeetCode-provided)
approach: For each maximal run of consecutive same-colored balloons, exactly one must survive; to minimize total removal time, keep the one with the largest `neededTime` and remove the rest. The cost for a run is (sum of all times in the run) − (maximum time in the run). A single left-to-right pass groups consecutive identical colors, accumulates the sum and max per group, and adds `sum − max` to the answer. This is correct because every run of length ≥ 2 must lose all but one balloon, and keeping the costliest-to-remove one minimizes the total.
hints: For any maximal block of consecutive same-colored balloons, how many are allowed to remain, and what determines which one to keep? n ≤ 10^5 rules out checking every possible subset of removals.

Greedy single pass: for each maximal run of identical colors, keep the balloon with the largest `neededTime` and remove the rest. For "abaac" with times [1,2,3,4,5], the run "aa" at indices 2-3 has sum 7 and max 4, so cost = 7 − 4 = 3.

```
total = 0, i = 0
while i < n:
    j = i, runSum = 0, runMax = 0
    while j < n and colors[j] == colors[i]:
        runSum += neededTime[j]
        runMax = max(runMax, neededTime[j])
        j += 1
    total += runSum - runMax
    i = j
return total
```

**All same color** - entire string is one color, requiring removal of all but one balloon
`Input: colors = "aaaa", neededTime = [4,1,4,1]` → `Expected: 6`
⚠️ Bug: adding min(neededTime[i], neededTime[i-1]) for each adjacent pair instead of tracking the full group → returns 3

**Last group** - the final run of same-colored balloons at the string's end
`Input: colors = "aabaa", neededTime = [1,2,3,4,1]` → `Expected: 2`
⚠️ Bug: only adding group cost when the color changes, not after the loop ends → returns 1

**Already colorful** - no consecutive duplicates exist
`Input: colors = "abc", neededTime = [1,2,3]` → `Expected: 0`
⚠️ Bug: adding runSum without subtracting runMax for single-element groups → returns 6

**Two-element group at start** - duplicate at the beginning of the string
`Input: colors = "aab", neededTime = [3,1,2]` → `Expected: 1`
⚠️ Bug: starting the scan at index 1 and not including neededTime[0] in the first group's sum → returns 0

followUps.q: What if at most k consecutive balloons of the same color are allowed (instead of just 1)?
followUps.a: For each run longer than k, keep the k balloons with the largest neededTime and remove the rest. Use a min-heap of size k per group to track the k largest values. TC: O(n log k), SC: O(k).

followUps.q: What if colors can be any character, not just lowercase English letters?
followUps.a: The algorithm only compares adjacent characters for equality, so the character set is irrelevant. No change to the approach. TC: O(n), SC: O(1).

followUps.q: What if the input arrives as a stream and you cannot store the full arrays in memory?
followUps.a: Process one element at a time, tracking only the previous color, the current group's running sum, and its maximum. When the color changes, flush the group's cost. TC: O(n), SC: O(1).
